full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white close-up shows a pencil drawing of a face in progress, with a real hand holding a sharpened pencil against the drawn cheek. The drawing fills almost the entire frame, cropped tightly at the forehead, left cheek, right nose, and lower lip. The nearer eye sits high on the left, its iris, pupil, lashes, and pale catchlight drawn in fine graphite detail. The far eye appears near the upper right as a partly hidden sliver behind the bridge of the nose. A strong brow and delicate short strokes describe skin folds around the near eye. The nose projects across the right half, where soft gray shading rounds the bridge and darkens beneath the nostril. Lips are visible along the lower edge, lightly closed and surrounded by minute pencil texture. In the foreground at the lower left, a hand partly blurs as it grips the dark pencil. The pointed graphite tip touches a spot below the near eye, making the act of drawing part of the image rather than a separate studio scene. The white paper remains visible along the far left and right, with almost no background beyond the work surface. The viewpoint is extremely close and angled toward the portrait, so both the shaded artwork and working hand occupy the same shallow visual space. Soft diffuse light from above and left reveals the pencil strokes without a strong cast shadow. Layered hatching, tiny pores, and smooth rubbed graphite transitions create a convincing rounded face, while the visible pencil tip reminds the viewer that the realism is handmade. The overall composition is focused and intimate, balancing a sharply modeled gaze with the softened foreground hand and the quiet white paper.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白近景呈现一张正在绘制的人脸铅笔画，一只真实的手握尖铅笔触在画出的脸颊上。画面几乎被绘画填满，额头、左颊、右侧鼻部和下唇都被紧紧裁切。靠近观者的眼睛位于左上，其虹膜、瞳孔、睫毛和浅色眼神光以细致石墨描绘。远侧眼睛在右上方、鼻梁后面只露出一部分。浓眉和纤细短线勾出近眼周围的皮肤褶皱。鼻子伸向右半部，柔灰阴影塑造鼻梁弧度，并在鼻孔下加深。嘴唇沿底边可见，轻轻闭合，周围布满微小铅笔肌理。左下方前景，一只手握着深色铅笔而略显模糊。尖锐石墨笔尖触在近眼下方，使绘制动作成为画面一部分，而非另一个工作室场景。最左与最右仍能见白纸，除了作画表面几乎没有背景。视点极近且斜向肖像，使带阴影的作品与作画手位于同一个浅视觉空间。来自上方偏左的柔和漫射光显出铅笔笔触，没有强烈投影。层叠排线、细微毛孔与擦匀的石墨过渡构成可信的圆润面容，显露的笔尖则提醒观者这份写实来自手工。整体构图集中而亲密，以塑形清晰的目光平衡被柔化的前景手和安静白纸。
style_prompt_en: A graphite-drawing treatment builds highly realistic volume from fine layered hatching, tiny stippled marks, and softly rubbed gray transitions. Near-white paper highlights meet deep charcoal accents in small focal areas; most surfaces occupy a wide range of restrained middle grays. Edges are exceptionally precise where attention concentrates and gradually lose definition toward a close crop. Diffuse upper light reveals the graphite texture without hard cast shadows or glossy color. A near sharp working point and a softer foreground mass create shallow depth while keeping the hand-made surface visible. The image feels patient, intimate, and technically assured, with every gradient traceable to accumulated pencil marks.
style_prompt_zh: 石墨铅笔画处理通过细密层叠排线、微小点痕和轻轻擦匀的灰色过渡，建立高度写实的体积。近白纸面高光与局部深炭色强调相遇，大部分表面分布在克制而丰富的中灰范围。注意力集中的边缘极其准确，靠近裁切处则逐渐失去明确度。上方漫射光显露石墨肌理，没有生硬投影或彩色光泽。近处清楚的工作尖点与较柔软的前景体块制造浅纵深，同时保留手工表面。画面耐心、亲密而技法稳健，每道渐层都能追溯到累积的铅笔痕迹。
theme_en: A hand shading a highly detailed pencil drawing of a face
theme_zh: 一只手正在为细致的人脸铅笔画加深阴影
name: Pencil drawing
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
